confidence_notes: Numbeo Cambridge prices are current to Oct 2026 and based on 685 entries from 76 contributors; accommodation is a holistic estimate without live listings. Cocktail and wine use local price relationships to draft beer because drink evidence is weaker; Expatistan’s sparse cocktail estimate is only a rough cross-check.
comparable_city_reasoning: Cambridge is a high-demand university and heritage destination; food and drink sit toward the upper end of UK regional-city prices, while accommodation is estimated below London but above the national average.
